name: Nav2 regulated pure pursuit path-following controller
summary: Official C++ Nav2 controller implementation for lookahead curvature, velocity regulation, heading rotation and configurable collision checking. It returns velocity commands inside a configured Nav2 stack; this single source is not a standalone or runtime-verified robot task.

Preserve attribution, license and applicable notices. The root repository is multi-license. packages: Complete pinned nav2_regulated_pure_pursuit_controller ROS 2 package and ament_cmake build environment
C++17-capable toolchain and complete package helper sources/headers
system: Configured Nav2 controller server and lifecycle node loading this plugin
Valid plan, robot pose/speed, goal checker, tf2 transforms, footprint and costmap
requirements.notes: computeVelocityCommands locks parameter/costmap state, transforms the plan, selects and publishes lookahead points, calculates curvature, handles heading rotation/reversing and applies curvature, cost and goal-approach velocity constraints. Configured collision detection can throw NoValidControl through a separate collision checker; its presence is not a measured safety guarantee. The source returns TwistStamped to its host rather than publishing cmd_vel itself. It creates lifecycle publishers for received_global_plan, lookahead_point, curvature_lookahead_point and is_rotating_to_heading. Cancellation can use configured deceleration; plan/reset/speed-limit methods change internal state. CMake explicitly requests C++17. Package version 1.3.14 and cached jazzy ref are declarations, not tested compatibility. Headers, path/parameter/collision helpers, ROS graph, transforms, footprint and host server must be supplied and reviewed.

invocation.notes: Registered C++ shared-library plugin, not a ros2 run executable, standalone file or Hub recipe. Pinned nav2_regulated_pure_pursuit_controller/nav2_regulated_pure_pursuit_controller.xml names the class/base/library; CMake builds and exports it. A configured lifecycle host must load it through the intended Nav2 server. Read the full package, parameters and dependencies before any build or activation. The Hub only indexes one inert source file and did not compile, load or execute a plugin, ROS node, simulator or robot.
